events.title: Indian Shares Modestly Lower In Cautious Trade
events.description: Indian shares were modestly lower in early trade on Friday as global technology stocks stabilized after recent string of losses and a strike on an oil refinery in Saudi Arabia's southern Jazan region heightened concerns over supply disruptions from the Middle East.

events.title: Australian Market Extends Early Gains In Mid-market
events.description: The Australian stock market is extending its early gains in mid-market moves on Friday after opening slightly in the red, adding to the gains in the previous session, following the positive cues from European markets and lack of cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 is moving above the 8,800 level, with gains across most sectors led by mining, energy and technology stocks.

events.title: Asian Markets Trade Mostly Higher
events.description: Asian stock markets are trading mostly higher on Friday, following the broadly positive cues from European markets and lack of cues from Wall Street overnight due to Thanksgiving holiday, as traders return to buy semiconductor and technology stocks on stabilized sentiment over AI trade following a sharp sell-off earlier in the week. They also stepped in to pick up recently beaten-down shares.

events.title: Indian Shares Seen Lower After Houthi Attack On Key Saudi Refinery
events.description: Indian shares look set to open lower on Friday as investors react a pause in AI stock sell-off and rising oil prices in the wake of growing attacks on Saudi Arabia's energy infrastructure.

events.title: Japanese Market Notably Higher
events.description: The Japanese market is notably higher on Friday, extending the gains in the previous session, following the positive cues from European markets and lack of cues from Wall Street overnight. The Nikkei 225 is moving up to near the 57,750 level, with gains in exporters, automakers and technology stocks partially offset by weakness in index heavyweights.

events.title: Australian Market Modestly Higher
events.description: The Australian stock market is trading modestly higher on Friday after opening slightly in the red, adding to the gains in the previous session, following the positive cues from European markets and lack of cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 is moving up to near the 8,800 level, with gains in iron ore miners, energy and technology stocks.

events.title: Spain's Pablo Hernández De Cos To Be Next ECB Chief
events.description:
Spain's Pablo Hernández de Cos is set to succeed Christine Lagarde as the European Central Bank president when the latter steps down in February next year.
He would be the first Spaniard to be at the helm of the central bank for the single-currency bloc.

events.title: Indian Shares End Modestly Higher Led By IT Stocks
events.description: Indian shares eked out modest gains on Thursday as oil prices fell after rising for two straight sessions and investors took in their stride a fresh round of proposed U.S. tariffs, which are not yet in effect and are unlikely to be implemented before late January 2027.

events.title: Swiss Franc Falls Against Majors
events.description: The Swiss franc weakened against other major currencies in the European session on Thursday.

events.title: Gold Prices Mixed In Cautious Trade As Dollar Steadies
events.description: Gold prices were mixed on Thursday as the U.S. dollar regained some ground after a two-day corrective move on the back of falling Treasury yields.

events.title: Oil Prices Drift Lower After Two-day Gain
events.description: Oil prices were moving lower on Thursday after rising for two straight sessions.

events.title: German GfK Consumer Sentiment Improves
events.description: German consumer sentiment is set to improve moderately in December but remained at a low level on weak economic expectations and inflation fears, monthly survey data by the Nuremberg Institute for Market Decisions and GfK showed Thursday. The forward-looking consumer climate index rose to -30.2 in December from -30.9 in the prior month.

events.title: European Shares Rally As Tariff Fears Ease
events.description: European stocks rose sharply on Thursday, with banks and technology stocks leading the surge despite concerns over the Trump administration's new tariff announcement and the outlook for AI trade.
